Markets.title: RBI may hike repo rate by 25 bps as inflation and oil risks mount: Sunil Sanghai
Markets.summary: Sunil Sanghai predicts the RBI may increase the repo rate by 25 basis points in October to address rising inflation, high oil prices, and pressure on the rupee. He notes that strong foreign reserves and a manageable current account will serve as important economic buffers.

Markets.title: IT Q2 Preview: Muted growth, steady margins likely; deal conversion, AI deflation in focus
Markets.summary: India's leading IT firms are expected to report modest revenue growth and stable margins for the second quarter due to constrained discretionary spending. Additionally, geopolitical issues are prolonging decision-making cycles, while AI advancements threaten to impact traditional services.

Markets.title: IPO bonanza: 29 companies to list this week; GMPs signal returns of up to 59%
Markets.summary: Twenty-nine companies are scheduled to debut on the stock market this week following a busy fundraising period. Grey market trends show potential returns of up to 59% for Vans Electroengineerings, while several other firms are heading toward flat debuts.

Markets.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Date, venue, speakers, agenda and registration
Markets.summary: The ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0 will take place on October 8 at the ITC Maratha in Mumbai. Investment experts will gather to discuss wealth creation, alternative assets, structured debt, and family office investment strategies.

Markets.title: Bajaj Finance: Why this rare Nifty outperformer is likely to reward investors in a muted market
Markets.summary: Bajaj Finance has outperformed the declining Nifty index in 2026, falling only 2% compared to the broader market's 13% drop. According to Jefferies, this relative strength is driven by a recent Rs 17,500 crore capital raise that is expected to boost the company's book value per share.

Markets.title: What will bring foreign investors back to Indian stock market? 5 things that should go right
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors sold over Rs 25,000 crore of Indian equities in September due to high US bond yields, elevated crude prices, and a weaker rupee. Foreign investors could return to the Indian market if bond yields and oil prices cool, the currency stabilizes, Q2 earnings are strong, and valuations become more attractive.

Geo-Political.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
Geo-Political.summary: An unverified video captured a Russian drone striking the Northern Bridge in Kyiv, creating a large fireball as vehicles crossed. The attack occurred during a surprise visit to the Ukrainian capital by the German chancellor.

Geo-Political.title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
Geo-Political.summary: Australian state police and security agencies are investigating the co-pilot of a Flydubai flight following his attempt to seize control of the aircraft while traveling to Israel. Authorities are specifically examining the individual's connections to Australia.

Geo-Political.title: Tennessee prison chief to resign after Christa Pike's failed execution
Geo-Political.summary: Tennessee Department of Correction Commissioner Lisa Helton is resigning following the botched execution of death row inmate Christa Pike. Pike survived two lethal injection attempts and remains in critical condition.

Geo-Political.title: Cornell president says university 'must do better' after frat house rape allegations
Geo-Political.summary: Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff called allegations that a female student was drugged and gang-raped at a fraternity house deeply disturbing. He stated that the university must improve its response following these incidents.

Geo-Political.title: 'Anger in the streets': Tens of thousands protest in Spain over housing crisis
Geo-Political.summary: Tens of thousands of people protested across Spain on Saturday over the country's housing crisis. The demonstrations occurred after the government failed to pass emergency housing legislation through parliament.

Geo-Political.title: What to know about Brazil's election pitting Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro
Geo-Political.summary: Brazil's presidential election features a close race between left-wing incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. Recent polls indicate that neither candidate holds a decisive advantage heading into the closely contested vote.

Data & Insights.title: India’s food market: $600 bn estimate; 7% CAGR — from primary producer to high-value global processing powerhouse
Data & Insights.summary: India's $600 billion food market is growing at a 7% CAGR as the country transitions into a high-value global processing powerhouse. This shift aims to double current agri-food exports of $53 billion through increased value addition and market access from the India-EU Free Trade Agreement.

Data & Insights.title: FM Sitharaman calls for open, predictable global economic ties amid rising uncertainty
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Sitharaman emphasized the need for open and predictable global economic relationships to navigate rising geopolitical tensions and trade barriers. She also called for increased private sector investment within India to strengthen the domestic economy.

Data & Insights.title: India weathered global shocks, retained policy space to respond: FM Nirmala Sitharaman
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that India's economic resilience was driven by fiscal prudence, infrastructure development, and banking reforms. She highlighted the country's 7.8% GDP growth for Q1 FY27 and $766 billion in forex reserves while urging for increased private investment and strategic resource security.

Data & Insights.title: White-collar hiring shifts towards specialised AI skills, experienced professionals in September: Report
Data & Insights.summary: In September, white-collar hiring shifted toward candidates with specialized AI skills and experienced professionals. Consequently, the job market has become increasingly selective for freshers and mid-career job seekers.

Data & Insights.title: G7 unlocks 100 million barrels: Who holds world’s emergency oil and who decides when to release it? A deep dive
Data & Insights.summary: The G7 has released 100 million barrels of emergency oil to counter tightening global supplies. Governments and international agencies control these reserves and determine when to release them based on market disruptions.

Data & Insights.title: Forex reserves plunge record $18.3 billion as RBI steps in to support rupee
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves suffered a record weekly decline of $18.34 billion, dropping to $747.56 billion for the week ending September 25. The steep drop occurred as the Reserve Bank of India intervened in the market to support the weakening rupee.

India.title: Ex-Village Head Shot Dead In Punjab, Family Claims Brother Killed Him For Land
India.summary: Former village head Navtej Singh was shot dead by two men on a motorcycle while returning home in Punjab on Saturday. His family claims that his brother killed him in a dispute over land.

India.title: CBSE Class 10 Passing Criteria: No Change In 33% Rule For 2027 Exams
India.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has confirmed that the Class 10 passing criteria will remain unchanged for the 2026-27 academic year. Students must continue to achieve a combined total of 33 percent marks in both theory and internal assessments to pass.

India.title: "Drunk" Truck Driver Charges With Dagger At Assam BJP MLA, Arrested
India.summary: An intoxicated truck driver charged at an Assam BJP MLA with a dagger. Local residents thrashed the driver before handing him over to the police, who subsequently arrested him.
